people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Jephthah
people.line: A judge of Israel, known for his tragic vow.

translations.web: Jephthah vowed a vow to Yahweh, and said, “If you will indeed deliver the children of Ammon into my hand,
translations.bsb: Jephthah made this vow to the LORD: “If indeed You will deliver the Ammonites into my hand,

translations.asv: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto Jehovah, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver the children of Ammon into my hand,
